Curated vs Enumerated

The 435k corpus was crawled from 481 hand-picked topics. The 10M build walks the whole of Wikimedia Commons instead. Both populations now sit in the same index, so this shows what each actually returns — same model, same ranking, same safety filter.

curated · 435,540 images · 481 topics enumerated · 24,000 images · generator=allimages

This is the honest comparison, because it does not depend on how many images each population has. It is simply what you get if you reach in and pull out a handful.

What to look for

Not which grid has more images — which grid has images you would drop into a timeline. Scanned book pages, herbarium sheets, boundary maps and coats of arms are real photographs of real things, and useless for a mood board. If the enumerated column is mostly those, then the remaining ~9.5M images of this build add cost and dilute results rather than making the product better.
